title: Father's Last Wish
next_chapter_hook: The invisible threads behind Ye Qing, where do they pull her toward? When the truth of betrayal is revealed, what awaits her and Chen Ji?

text.content: The light of the temporal rift enveloped Chen Ji entirely, that familiar yet terrifying aura rushing toward him. The final line on the list still floated before his eyes—'Option to become the next Chess Player'—ironically, before he could contemplate its meaning, that voice had already spoken. 'You've finally arrived.' Chen Tianming's voice was hoarse and weary, as if it had traveled across ten thousand years to finally reach this moment. Mo Xiansheng's figure trembled slightly behind Chen Ji, a solemnity he had never displayed before.

dialogue.content: This old servant has waited too long. Young Master, since that farewell ten thousand years ago, Master's soul has been shattered, held together only by sheer will to survive until today.

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at that ethereal figure, its features seven-tenths similar to his own, though with a sharpness between the brows that he himself lacked. Around Chen Tianming in the temporal rift, countless tiny points of light swirled like shattered memories drifting in the air. With each sentence he spoke, those lights dimmed further, as if his very existence was visibly dissolving.

Upon hearing this, Chen Tianming actually forced a bitter smile. That expression on his ethereal face appeared particularly desolate, yet carried a resignation Chen Ji could not comprehend. He did not answer directly, but slowly raised his hand, pointing to Chen Ji's chest. 'The blood in your veins is genuine, but you are not merely a child of the Chen family.' His voice suddenly became solemn, 'Ten thousand years ago, I knew the Eye of Heavenly Ways could not be opposed by force, and that the so-called cycle of sacrifice would eventually devour everything. Thus I needed a piece, a piece that could leap beyond the board itself.'

dialogue.content: Master... you mean Young Master was from the beginning the piece you set in motion to break the situation?

text.content: Chen Tianming's form flickered, more lights peeling away from his body. Without answering Mo Xiansheng's question, he simply stared at Chen Ji, his gaze overflowing with complex emotions—guilt, anticipation, and a fear Chen Ji had never witnessed. 'Your mother was the last descendant of the Chen bloodline, and I...' He paused, 'I was originally chosen by the Tianji Record, yet after glimpsing the truth of the Eye of Heavenly Ways, I chose to rebel. To ensure you possessed the potential to break the cycle, I fused fragments of my soul into your body.'

dialogue.content: So the Tianji Record chose me, not because of my talent, but because... I am your son?

text.content: 'The Tianji Record chooses possibilities.' Chen Tianming's voice grew increasingly faint, 'And you, you are the most perfect possibility I spent ten thousand years searching for. Mo Xiansheng giving you the Tianji Record Fragment was no coincidence—it was part of the plan.' Chen Ji's fists had unconsciously clenched. He had believed himself the one controlling everything, weaving schemes in the shadows, but now his father told him he was merely another arranged piece. This realization should have enraged him, yet gazing at Chen Tianming's dissipating form, an inexplicable soreness rose within him.

dialogue.content: Young Master... the Master has yet to finish speaking.

text.content: Chen Tianming's form had grown so translucent it was nearly invisible, his time nearly exhausted. 'Chen Ji, I have one final request—not to destroy the Eye of Heavenly Ways, for that thing cannot be destroyed.' His voice began fragmenting, 'It is to utterly break the sacrifice cycle... so that there will be no next me, and no next you.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, and Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. This meant... 'You want me to end the Tianji Record's legacy?' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, 'Make me the last Chess Player?'

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming's remnant soul awaits your answer, his existence visibly dissipating. At this moment, Chen Ji must make a choice—to comply with his father's last wish, or to carve out his own path?

choices.description: Agree to his father's request, promising to become the last one to break the sacrifice cycle, ending this ten-thousand-year chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Losing the Possibility of Tianji Record Legacy
choices.visible_reward: Receiving Chen Tianming's Complete Memory Inheritance
choices.risk_hint: This means you will personally end your greatest reliance

text.content: A genuine smile finally appeared on Chen Tianming's face, a tenderness Chen Ji had never witnessed. 'Good child...' His form began rapidly dissolving, but those scattered lights seemed to find their destination, rushing into Chen Ji's brow center all at once. In an instant, ten thousand years of memory torrents flooded his mind—Chen Tianming's life, the truth of the Chen family's destruction, the horror of the Eye of Heavenly Ways, and... the name deliberately buried. Ye Qing. 'Wait—' Chen Ji wanted to pursue the question, but Chen Tianming's voice had already faded, leaving only the final words echoing in the air.

choices.description: Refuse his father's controlling desire, choose to continue playing the chess game, become the next Eye of Heavenly Ways.
choices.visible_reward: Retain the complete power of the Tianji Record, continue playing chess with the world
choices.risk_hint: You will walk the same path as the Eye of Heavenly Ways

dialogue.content: I will not become anyone's piece, including yours.

text.content: Chen Tianming's eyes dimmed sharply, not disappointment, but a deeper sorrow. He seemed to have anticipated this answer long ago. 'As expected... you are like me.' His form dissolved even faster, as if Chen Ji's refusal had抽走了 his last ounce of strength to persist. Before completely vanishing, he cast his gaze toward Mo Xiansheng, that look containing some commission Chen Ji could not decipher. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, yet he uttered not a single word.

choices.description: Neither simple obedience nor blunt refusal, but proposing a third possibility that breaks the cycle yet preserves the legacy.
choices.visible_reward: May find the true path to break the situation
choices.risk_hint: This plan has never been attempted by anyone

dialogue.content: I don't need to become anyone. I want to create a path even you never imagined.

text.content: A flash of surprise crossed Chen Tianming's eyes, followed by profound shock. He gazed at this son who resembled his younger self so closely, then suddenly burst into laughter. That laughter was hoarse and desolate, yet finally transformed into relief. 'Good... good!' He laughed as he dissipated, yet a wisp of essence precisely shot into Chen Ji's brow center—that was the inheritance beyond the last wish itself, the secret of how to completely release the Tianji Record's power without counteraction. Mo Xiansheng trembled with agitation: 'Young Master, this... this is the forbidden path even the Master never touched!'

The temporal rift slowly closed, Chen Tianming's aura had completely dissipated from this world. But in the instant the final light vanished, a voice suddenly echoed in Chen Ji's mind—that was Chen Tianming's last strand of divine thought before death, like deliberate arrangement, or final struggle in despair. 'Ye Qing... she is being manipulated by a higher existence behind the scenes...' Chen Ji's body shuddered, pupils constricting sharply. Ye Qing, that Holy Sect Saint, the ally he thought he had recruited—her betrayal had other secrets? Was she a piece in someone else's hands from the start? Or could it be... she herself did not know she was being manipulated?

Mo Xiansheng's voice pulled Chen Ji back from contemplation. 'Young Master, the Master has passed. But the inheritance you received... is far from complete.' His remnant soul drifted before Chen Ji, solemnly taking out a bamboo scroll gleaming with a faint light. 'This is the ultimate mystery the Master comprehended through ten thousand years—'Heavenly Fate Returns to the Void'. When cultivated to mastery, it can completely counterbalance the Tianji Record's power to heaven, thus ending sacrifice and breaking the cycle of reincarnation.' Chen Ji took the bamboo scroll, and as his fingertips touched the cold bamboo pieces, an indescribable heaviness surged in his heart. He raised his head toward the gradually dimming temporal rift—nothing remained within, only endless void and a final riddle a father left for his son.

dialogue.content: Young Master, what do you intend to do?

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He tucked the bamboo scroll into his breast, his gaze penetrating the dissipating temporal rift, as if he could see through to some figure scheming ten thousand miles away. Ye Qing... he recalled her complex gaze each time she looked at him, recalling the confusion and struggle hidden beneath her Holy Sect mist. If she truly was being manipulated, then her current situation... 'Return first.' Chen Ji's voice恢复了往日的calm, 'Some things, I need to ask her in person.' Mo Xiansheng hesitated, then ultimately sighed. He watched Chen Ji's departing figure, his heart filled with mixed emotions. This young man was finally about to face the most dangerous truth—and that truth's background likely involved far more than a single Holy Sect Saint.
